card.name: Start of the word inadvertent
card.fires_on: The first part of the word "inadvertent" (split as inadvert + ent) in warnings about accidental administration, overdose or injection. One stray case is a city name (Asheville) in railroad history.

modes.label: Inadvertent in warnings
modes.description: The word "inadvertent" begins after avoid, prevent, even if, or reports of, before overdose, injection or administration.

modes.label: Place name outlier
modes.description: A town name after a railroad reached it, in history text.
modes.example: It took another year before the railroad reached<< Asheville>>.

card.plain: It fires on the opening of the word "inadvertent" when labels warn about accidental dosing or injection.
